lines.text: Lithia US: “On track for pilot in two Lithia US stores in Q4 FY25, with the wider roll-out to Lithia US stores starting in mid-FY26” (H1-25) → now “Two Lithia US dealers set to go live with Pinewood.AI as their core platform in Q4 2026” and “Wider roll-out across Lithia’s US and Canadian dealerships expected to commence in H1 2027”
lines.span: About a year later on both steps

lines.text: Marshalls rollout: “the rollout of the Pinewood.AI system is now expected to commence in the second half of 2026” (Mar-26, repeated Apr-26) → Marshalls not mentioned in H1-26

Churn: “Net customer churn remained very low at 0.7% for H1 FY26 (H1 FY25: 0.3%)” while the CEO review cites “an improved net customer churn of -0.7% in H1 FY26”; H1-25 metric was “Net user churn (excluding Lithia) remained minimal at 0.3% in H1 FY25”
lines.span: Churn more than doubled; metric renamed

lines.text: Headline “Strong strategic and operational progress, alongside continued growth” beside “H1 FY26 underlying profit before tax of £3.8m down 13.6% (H1 FY25: £4.4m)”; cash £23.9m vs £30.3m
